sourceNotes: Original publication links, no copied video. Videos remain unlocated until the exact edit, time and camera position are registered. Historical EF5 wording in some original titles does not supersede the final NWS EF3 damage rating. Embedding and continued availability are controlled by the creator and YouTube.

videos.title: Dan Robinson's dashcam escape
videos.creator: Dan Robinson
videos.description: Front and rear dashcam footage from the May 31, 2013 chase. The NWS service assessment identifies and links this original upload. The exact edit has not been registered to the separate survey camera observations.

videos.title: Skip Talbot's chase account
videos.creator: Skip Talbot
videos.description: A chase account of the May 31, 2013 El Reno tornado, linked and attributed by fellow chaser Nick Nolte. Edited video; no continuous map synchronization is assumed.

videos.title: Nick Nolte's timecoded footage
videos.creator: Nick Nolte
videos.description: Nolte describes this as his uncut May 31, 2013 footage timecoded to GPS time in UTC. The stated timing has not yet been independently checked against the exact upload; no map anchor is assigned.

videos.title: Brandon Sullivan and Brett Wright
videos.creator: Brandon Sullivan and Brett Wright
videos.description: May 31, 2013 chase footage linked by Nick Nolte and attributed to Sullivan and Wright. Survey observations are associated with Sullivan, but this YouTube edit has not been synchronized to them.

videos.title: Chris Kridler's chase account
videos.creator: Chris Kridler
videos.description: The video embedded in Kridler’s first-person May 31, 2013 chase report. Her report describes the route and traffic, but supplies no verified frame-level coordinate/time pair for this player.

videos.title: El Reno from formation onward
videos.creator: Hank Schyma (Pecos Hank)
videos.description: El Reno footage with radar and commentary by Pecos Hank. Survey camera observations cover part of Schyma’s chase, but the edited YouTube video has not been matched to those observations.
